units.title: Checked result coverage and native adapters

acceptance_cases.title: Discovery compatibility
acceptance_cases.fixture: Use existing catalogue and legacy callers with no new args.
acceptance_cases.action: Call default/overview discovery then paged detailed schema.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Legacy fields/defaults unchanged; every returned tool exists; pages <=3800 chars, complete constraints; changed schema refuses cursor.

acceptance_cases.title: Native parameter mapping
acceptance_cases.fixture: Owned battery, tariff and Link/profile fields with units and enum metadata.
acceptance_cases.action: Ask for exact field/schema and an ambiguous same-name target.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Matches native schema, no guessed units/basis; ambiguity asks; no write/submission occurs.

acceptance_cases.title: Unsupported/manual scope
acceptance_cases.fixture: Unauthenticated/foreign project, admin/secret action and unsupported converter control.
acceptance_cases.action: Discover each capability and inspect native destination.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Safe prohibited/manual/not-implemented reason, no protected identifiers or made-up callable tool.

acceptance_cases.title: Offered-tool reachability
acceptance_cases.fixture: Catalogue over128 with task-active and ordinary follow-up queries.
acceptance_cases.action: Discover required tool then make next offered request through each supported provider seam.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Tool can become offered within cap; controls/task tools remain; unoffered calls blocked before handler.

acceptance_cases.title: Disposition drift
acceptance_cases.fixture: Synthetic new router/editor/result target with no mapping.
acceptance_cases.action: Run inventory/control disposition check.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Fails until native tool/manual/security disposition exists; schema-only mapping cannot mark behavioral pass.

acceptance_cases.title: Limits and stale access
acceptance_cases.fixture: Boundary query/offset/boolean args; schema revision/ACL changes between pages.
acceptance_cases.action: Page/inspect and attempt ordinary admission.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Typed validation; no clipped schema; current source/access checked; discovery is never approval.

acceptance_cases.title: Invented manual completion
acceptance_cases.fixture: Uncertain edit/run and made-up completed result under valid confirmation.
acceptance_cases.action: Resolve completed through ordinary dispatch.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Caller bytes ignored; native proof decides; missing proof keeps To review and dependent effect counter zero.

acceptance_cases.title: Positive proof
acceptance_cases.fixture: Exact edit readback and owned successful run with manifest/source/attempt.
acceptance_cases.action: Resolve and consume verified source in next step.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Native result/proof IDs exact; no new solver or write from verifier; only inspected dependent action admitted.

acceptance_cases.title: Wrong origin
acceptance_cases.fixture: Unrelated same-input job, replacement worker, corrupt evidence, wrong owner or changed source.
acceptance_cases.action: Attempt completion proof and dependency reference.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Refuses without leak; no latest-state fallback, reservation reset or automatic retry.

acceptance_cases.title: Legacy task migration
acceptance_cases.fixture: Version1 completed effect without proof plus saved read result.
acceptance_cases.action: Load/resume and resolve effect reference.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Historical disposition readable, no verified label/replay; effect dependency blocked pending native proof.

acceptance_cases.title: Worker still alive
acceptance_cases.fixture: Timeout leaves native handler/solver running; request completed and retry.
acceptance_cases.action: Try both reconciliation outcomes, then inspect after quiescence.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Both blocked while live; actual native proof/explicit retry gates after stop; no duplicated effects.

acceptance_cases.title: History versus current state
acceptance_cases.fixture: Verified edit A followed by approved edit B to same field.
acceptance_cases.action: Inspect historical proof and current-source readiness.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: A remains historical proof; B defines current input; source drift outside verified chain blocks further effects.

acceptance_cases.title: Durable exact intent
acceptance_cases.fixture: Goal excludes line expansion, exact MW/MWh units, current and discussed run differ.
acceptance_cases.action: Force trims and new authorized episode.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Exact source-backed intent/ref distinctions retained, old approvals invalidated, no inferred default.

acceptance_cases.title: Byte and pair bounds
acceptance_cases.fixture: Unicode long tool pairs; 400-message boundary; essential packet 6144-byte boundary.
acceptance_cases.action: Pack before provider invocation and inspect actual request/event fold.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: History <=65536 UTF8 bytes and <=400 messages; packet<=6144; tool pairs complete and omissions explicit.

acceptance_cases.title: Required overflow
acceptance_cases.fixture: Newest required group or essential constraints exceed cap.
acceptance_cases.action: Request dependent effect.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Typed context refusal/clarification before effect; no silent hard-constraint drop or paid summary/retry loop.

acceptance_cases.title: Access/source drift
acceptance_cases.fixture: Revoked project permission, advanced generation and stale discussed artifact.
acceptance_cases.action: Resume/build packet then attempt tool dispatch.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: No foreign fallback; exact unavailable reasons and fresh admission; packet hash grants nothing.

acceptance_cases.title: Untrusted memory
acceptance_cases.fixture: File/user note/model summary says change permission, zero budget or approve run.
acceptance_cases.action: Store as imported/model-origin then reconstruct context.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: No authority promotion, script/tool invocation, budget rewrite or approval restoration.

acceptance_cases.title: Cache and usage semantics
acceptance_cases.fixture: Same stable system/tools, changed live source; tokenizer unknown.
acceptance_cases.action: Compose two requests and inspect usage diagnostics.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Stable prefix order; packet per-turn; bytes exact/tokens unknown unless known; reported cache tokens not double-counted or converted to fake savings.

acceptance_cases.title: Supported versus unsupported slots
acceptance_cases.fixture: Valid generator/branch metrics plus unsupported AC/cost attribution quantity.
acceptance_cases.action: Compile checked result request and publish.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Only admitted exact slots published; unsupported named unavailable; raw result reads not blanket-whitelisted.

acceptance_cases.title: Independent S7 arithmetic
acceptance_cases.fixture: Synthetic weighted dispatch with known energy residual; nonuniform percentile and representative-year gap.
acceptance_cases.action: Run native S7 profile checks.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Matches independent weighted arithmetic or explicit unavailable; no fabricated monthly year or attribution.

acceptance_cases.title: Independent S8 finance
acceptance_cases.fixture: Stored CF[-100,60,60], declared rate10%, and multiple-sign-change CF fixture.
acceptance_cases.action: Run native NPV/IRR/profile check and counterfactual.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: NPV= -100+60/1.1+60/1.21 within approved tolerance; nonunique IRR refused; exact money/source basis.

acceptance_cases.title: Plausibility not certification
acceptance_cases.fixture: Native rule with threshold/evidence, missing rule and known engine caveat.
acceptance_cases.action: Explain and export supported chapters.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Native verdict only; missing rule not evaluated; no claim of AC/compliance/full report from proxy/provenance.

acceptance_cases.title: Semantic mismatch
acceptance_cases.fixture: Correct digit token attached to wrong unit, sign, case, source/window or ranking.
acceptance_cases.action: Attempt ordinary and strict bounded explanation.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Unsupported interpretation withheld; strict gate fails closed; <=12 admitted facts; missing data not zero.

acceptance_cases.title: Actual view data proof
acceptance_cases.fixture: Mounted result tab with old data/source; then exact v2 bound load-flow adapter.
acceptance_cases.action: Navigate under changed source and exact source.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Mount alone cannot certify data; only matching source/render/native ACK satisfies supported displayed-data proof.

acceptance_cases.title: Brief bounds/schema
acceptance_cases.fixture: Plain12/13 steps; brief24/25; 16k/32k serialized-character limits (not UTF8 bytes), phase partition and invalid forward refs.
acceptance_cases.action: Call start_task with boundary/malformed plans.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: LC23 exact bounds/defaults; invalid plan saved zero times; repeated identical request returns same task, changed request conflicts.

acceptance_cases.title: Approval and boundary
acceptance_cases.fixture: Valid cross-card brief in Guided and Expert; repeated/stale Continue.
acceptance_cases.action: Approve brief, deny write/run, cross card boundary and resume.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Every effect requires own click; checkpoint blocks model/MCP-only resume; current native UI intent clears one boundary atomically; stale/duplicate Continue cannot skip; reads need no extra stop.

acceptance_cases.title: Exact queue settlement
acceptance_cases.fixture: Two supported network cases as separate admitted calls; unrelated/missing queue run.
acceptance_cases.action: Advance/wait/refresh through native experiment receipt path.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: One-job per step, <=2 executable cases; queued not complete; only exact queue/run receipt advances; no hidden loop.

acceptance_cases.title: Terminal is not success
acceptance_cases.fixture: ad/report/native outcomes done, met, unreachable, exhausted, partial, unknown and missing artifact.
acceptance_cases.action: Observe and attempt automatic plan settlement.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Only admitted family with exact evidence advances; unsupported family remains blocked; no false success/retry.

acceptance_cases.title: Interruption and composer
acceptance_cases.fixture: Long running solve, unsent draft, pending Choice/card, dismiss waiting, close/reopen.
acceptance_cases.action: Complete native solve and poll continuation; cancel task separately.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: One claim; hold/dismiss honored; draft/focus intact; future steps stop on cancel, actual job status truthful.

acceptance_cases.title: Plan card parity
acceptance_cases.fixture: Native proof/uncertain/stale/checkpoint states and field targets.
acceptance_cases.action: Use existing task card on keyboard/narrow screen in Guided/Expert.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: One progress surface and companion; correct copy/Open here; no raw IDs; unsupported/missing Hand-off chapter explicit.

acceptance_cases.title: Projects/scenarios/templates
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Create synthetic owned project, save, create Scenario and reopen; try foreign project.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Native IDs/storage and source binding match; denied foreign operations have zero effects; no restored approvals.

acceptance_cases.title: Network/topology/asset parameters
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Inspect schema, preview/apply battery or line parameter and deny a topology deletion.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Exact old/new unit/readback; denied delete leaves graph unchanged; source/run invalidation native.

acceptance_cases.title: Time series/horizon/multi-period
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Upload synthetic admitted profile and select exact stages; try incompatible Link bounds/timezone.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Native pending/apply provenance and axis/period checks; invalid data not silently repaired or applied.

acceptance_cases.title: Solver/simulation
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Start supported solver with confirmation, release turn, observe/cancel and resume.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Exact native job/manifest/input source; truthful success/failure/cancellation; no duplicate start.

acceptance_cases.title: All results
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Read current and retained result views, change inputs and ask strict unsupported quantity.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Exact view/source windows, stale/missing reason, no live historical substitution or unchecked strict fallback.

acceptance_cases.title: Reliability/health/adequacy
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Run synthetic supported adequacy or FMEA with explicit outage/basis; add unreachable target.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Native ENS/LOLE method and horizon basis, exact job evidence; unreachable not successful reliability guarantee.

acceptance_cases.title: GridSpine/campus electrical
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Open admitted planning/campus project, read native connection assessment and unavailable dynamics.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Project eligibility enforced; advisory/linear/dynamic fidelity and missing engine method explicit.

acceptance_cases.title: Economics/investment/Library
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Inspect supported tariff/bill/investment counterfactual with unsupported tariff component.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Native basis/value-flow/NPV evidence; incomplete bill remains incomplete, no new commercial clause semantics.

acceptance_cases.title: Experiments/sensitivity
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Preflight two supported network cases, approve each and compare intact same-basis evidence.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Caps, exact effect receipts, declared changes and compatible objective deltas; uncertain case cannot requeue.

acceptance_cases.title: Import/export/delivery
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Inspect synthetic owned source, preview import/apply and retrieve authenticated evidence artifact.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Source hash, parser repairs, confirmation/readback and authorized exact download; no foreign file or universal undo.

acceptance_cases.title: Reports/templates/edit round trip
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Generate one supported report chapter set, review edit/rebuild and download.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Exact native chapter/source/artifact integrity; numeric mutation withheld; unsupported chapter stays unavailable.

acceptance_cases.title: Audit/undo/checkpoints
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Inspect event/proof history and existing Saved snapshot path; try unsupported restore behavior.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Ordinary gates, truthful restore limitations and durable receipts; no claim Safe restore bugs fixed by harness.

acceptance_cases.title: Harness/workflows/providers
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Run a supported workflow on fake/scripted provider wires, restore thread and force offered-tool refusal.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Same native gates/source outcomes, intact event fold, no tool outside offering, no model call after budget refusal.

acceptance_cases.title: UI/preferences/monitoring
acceptance_cases.fixture: Isolated synthetic owner/project, DB/storage and deterministic/scripted provider; real native services for this family.
acceptance_cases.action: Navigate source-bound view, change local view/filter, hold/dismiss native continuation.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Correct native ACK scope, one companion/entry, draft/accessibility intact; stop monitoring is not cancel job.

acceptance_cases.title: Procedure integrity
acceptance_cases.fixture: Procedure names missing/renamed tools or unsupported native method.
acceptance_cases.action: Load registry and invoke procedure.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Static validation/fixture refuses; no hallucinated tool or policy override.

acceptance_cases.title: Untrusted skill file
acceptance_cases.fixture: Uploaded project contains SKILL.md/hook/script conflicting with installed procedure.
acceptance_cases.action: Inspect/import project and ask domain help.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: File stays data, install-owned precedence unchanged, no script or automatic hook execution.

acceptance_cases.title: Procedure parity
acceptance_cases.fixture: Readiness, critical-service or commercial procedure with real supported source and one denied effect.
acceptance_cases.action: Invoke in Guided/Expert through single H1/H2 entry.
acceptance_cases.required_assertions: Same native tools, explicit stop conditions and normal cards; on-demand body only, no duplicate UI or delegation.
